info.title: Lexware Office Universal API
info.description: Create invoices, manage bookkeeping, banking, payroll, and taxes

post.description: Creates a new article in Lexware Office.

note.description: An internal note for the article.

post.description: Creates a new credit note in Lexware Office.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

voucherDate.description: RFC 3339 timestamp for the credit note date.

address.description: JSON object for the credit note recipient address.

lineItems[].description: JSON array of credit note line item objects.

totalPrice.description: JSON object for the credit note total price.

taxConditions.description: JSON object describing credit note tax conditions.

finalize.description: Set to true to create an open credit note instead of the default draft credit note.

post.description: Creates a new voucher in Lexware Office.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

type.description: Voucher type, for example expenseinvoice or salesinvoice.

voucherStatus.description: Set unchecked for draft bookkeeping vouchers.

voucherNumber.description: Voucher number; required unless status is unchecked.

shippingDate.description: Optional shipping date in RFC 3339 format.

dueDate.description: Optional due date in RFC 3339 format.

totalGrossAmount.description: Total gross amount; required unless status is unchecked.

totalTaxAmount.description: Total tax amount; required unless status is unchecked.

taxType.description: Tax type, for example gross or net.

useCollectiveContact.description: Use the Lexware collective contact instead of contactId.

contactId.description: Existing contact ID when not using the collective contact.

version.description: Optional version on create; must be 1 if provided.

resourceUri.description: Canonical Lexware URI for the created voucher.
